theorems.name: Submission.lip_approx_graph_hole_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ p : ℝ, (n : ℝ) < p → ∃ ε δ₀ C₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ 0 < δ₀ ∧ 0 ≤ C₀ ∧ ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (δ ρ : ℝ), 0 < δ → δ ≤ δ₀ → V.AllardHypotheses H p δ ρ → ∀ (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ), (∀ x z, ‖f x - f z‖ ≤ ε * ‖x - z‖) → (∀ x ∈ closedBall (0 : Rn n) (δ * ρ / 2), ‖f x‖ ≤ δ * ρ / 32) → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (closedBall 0 (δ * ρ / 2) ∩ (q '' graphOver f (closedBall 0 (δ * ρ / 2)) \ V.support)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C₀ * (V.weight (closedBall 0 (3 * (δ * ρ) / 4) \ q '' graphOver f univ) + ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x in closedBall 0 (δ * ρ), hsNormSq (V.tangentProj x - (rotatedPlane q).starProjection) ∂V.weight))
